name: Roth.coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le'
source:
private lemma coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le' {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K[X]) (n : ι → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree ≤ n i) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).coeff (∑ i ∈ s, n i) = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff (n i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s has ih =>
    simp only [Finset.forall_mem_insert] at h
    rw [Finset.prod_insert has, Finset.sum_insert has, Finset.prod_insert has,
      coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le h.1 ((natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum h.2)),
      ih h.2]

what: The coefficient of a product at the sum of upper degree bounds equals the product of the coefficients at those bounds.
how: Finset induction applies coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le at each insertion; natDegree_prod_le controls the remaining product degree.
hypotheses: A coefficient field, finite product index set, and a natural degree upper bound on each polynomial factor.
